title: tier_pipe_width comment claims a 1:1.57:2.43 ladder ratio that the shipped values do not keep
detail: 4.5:7.4:10.5 is 1:1.64:2.33, not 1:1.57:2.43. The comment was drafted for the spec's proportional 4.7/7.4/11.4 ladder and never updated after the wide cap; it misstates the shipped invariant.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to the actual ladder (1:1.64:2.33) or state only the binding rule (wide band must stay below the house footprint).

title: Delivered park frame share 7.5% falls below the diff's own frozen AC band of ~8–10%
evidence: PR body line 55: "| park | 9.4% | 7.5% | ~9–11% |" — vs the frozen spec AC (_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-scale-depth.md:75): "then frame water share drops from ~49–51% to ~26–28% (margins canvas + edge-clustered world water) and parks stay an accent (~8–10%), measured from the re-blessed juice golden; numbers in the PR body."
detail: The spec's map AC says parks stay an accent at ~8–10% of the frame; the PR's own measurement reports 7.5% (MM ~9–11%). The briefing's intent ("park reads as accent, not a carpet") still holds, but the delivered number misses the diff's stated band.
recommended_fix: Either nudge MAP_PARK_LEVEL down (0.76 → ~0.74) to land in 8–10%, or amend the AC/PR body to explicitly justify the sub-8% accent share with the measurement.
